The '''mission to Bandomeer''' was a mission undertaken by [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].

==Prelude==
[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] old [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Xanatos]], had become leader of the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] and had headed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]].<ref name="Dark Rival">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref> Meanwhile, Obi-Wan Kenobi desperately wished to be a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], though he had a tough time controlling his anger. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] sent him and Qui-Gon to Bandomeer to investigate what had been happening.<ref name="RF">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]''</ref>

==The Mission==
As the leader of [[Offworld Mining Corporation]], Xanatos claimed that he desired peace between Offworld and rival company [[Arcona Mineral Harvest Corporation]], but secretly he planned to eliminate Arcona and take their [[ionite]] mines on Bandomeer for himself. He tricked Obi-Wan Kenobi into thinking he would not make it as Jinn's Padawan. He then sent him off to a mining platform through a trap door. With the help of Kenobi, Jinn thwarted his plans by disabling the charges. The planet was safe.<ref name="Dark Rival" />

==Aftermath==
Xanatos had fled into hiding, as he had did [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|the first time he and Qui-Gon faced off]].<ref name="Dark Rival" /> It would not be long before they knew the whereabouts of Xanatos.<ref name="Day of Reckoning">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Day of Reckoning]]''</ref>
